necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity for CPT 93247 despite the denial based on Reason Code PR-204.
